message: The other day, I found myself explaining to my grandson why I have enough bottled water to float a small boat. I told him it’s my way of being gloriously over-prepared for any storm that comes our way. He just rolled his eyes and said, 'But Grandma, what if we just get a drizzle?' I guess there’s a fine line between preparedness and paranoia, but I prefer to be on the safe side. How do you stay ready for whatever weather comes your way?
